column7: 24x7 WATER SUPPLY IN IDENTIFIED DMAs OF IMPHAL MUNICIPAL CORPORATION AREA
column10: The supply of water in Imphal city at present is on schedule basis, depending on the water availability and last for one or two hours only. The supply does not have enough pressure to flow directly from taps even at a ground floor level which leads to consumers installing suction pumps and storage reservoirs to collect the water during the scheduled water supply hours. As a result of this practice, water being supplied is distributed unevenly among the consumers. However, with the implementation of AMRUT Mission, the situation became better. Additionally, in case of intermittent water supply system, it is noticed that when the water is not flowing in the distribution pipes, water that had been leaking out of faulty joints or holes can be sucked back in. Under AMRUT Mission, the laying of distribution pipes in the corporation area is completed and installation of smart water meter is in progress. The installation of smart water meter is expected to reduce wastage of water as billing system is likely to be introduced as per their water consumption unlike the old flat rate tariff system. Continuous water supply is one of the important norms for AMRUT cities. "The Manual of Water Supply & Treatment" 3rd Edition CPHEEO, Ministry of Urban Development, New Delhi: states that, "The intermittent system suffers disadvantages, wherever possible, intermittent supply should he discouraged or convert it into the continuous supply system for better health and wealth of the citizens". As a first step to adoption of 24x7 water supply in Imphal city, two DMAs have been identified to take up the project on a pilot scale under AMRUT Mission 2.0, viz. (i) DMA (1): area covered by Chinga water supply scheme (ii) DMA (2): Ward No. 7 of Imphal Municipal Corporation. After successful implementation in these two areas, it can be replicated to other urban areas in the State. DMA (1): Chinga water supply scheme (4.5 MLD) is supplying treated water to consumers partly under IMC ward no. 15, 16 and 17 on alternate day basis. DMA (2): IMC ward no 7 is being provided by Nepra Menjor Water Supply scheme with OHT capacity of 0.45 ML and Service Reservoir of 0.67 ML.

Taking into consideration of all the above-mentioned issues, this scheme has been proposed to address the water scarcity in Doimukh Township. Under this project, it is proposed to provide water to Doimukh township by conjointly tapping a gravity-based surface  source (Luksin source) in addition to the already existing gravity source (Heri Nallah). column7: Water Supply to Kharsang Township
column10: The Kharsang township has been declared recently as Urban town by the state government by seeing the rapid growth and development of the township. The town is located at low altitude and is unable to tap water directly from gravity sources due to non avilibality of gravity sources nearby area. The present water supply to Kharsang Town is of Lift water supply through Bore well which is partially covered with pipe water supply under JJM programe. The present water supply to the township is of 55 LPCD which is very less as per the prescribed 135 LPCD of the Urban towns which has a deficit of 80 LPCD. Now, the present population of the Town has been worked to be 3909 Nos. as per the population forecast method of Geometrical Increase Method for 80 LPCD excluding the population of institution, offices etc. and the said excluding population has been included in water requirement calculation as per LPCD provision given in the CPHEEO Mannual. The ultimate design population of the project town for design period of 30 years is 8191 Nos. Therefore, a new water supply project is necessary to cater the daily water requirements of the Town as well as the other Govt. institutions, offices and publice places etc. in the town and due to non availability of gravity sources, it has been decided that the water shall be tapped from Namphuk river having a sufficient discharge by constructing a Jack well and shall be conveyed through 250 mm dia. HDPE Pipe to meet up the water demand of 2.20 MLD. The main line is of 1.50 KM distance from the proposed intake point to the proposed WTP and after the execution of this project, the consumers of the Khasang town will be highly benefited. Hence, this project is proposed under AMRUT.

column7: AUGMNENTATION OF SEWERAGE SYSTEM TO RELIEVE THE EXCESSIVE SEWER LOAD ON EXISTING TRUNK MAIN NEAR VILLAGE BURAIL BY PROVIDING ALTERNATE 800MM ID NP-3 PIPELINE AT V3 ROAD ON DIVIDING ROAD SECTOR 44-B/45-A, CHANDIGARH”
column10: The MCC will spend around approx. Rs. 2.35 Crore for this work. The sewer main trunk lines laid parallel to Shanti Path is taking sewer load of sectors i.e. 12, 14, 15, 24, 25, 33, 38 (West), Dadumajra etc. including Sector 45, Chandigarh. The line is primarily of egg shaped 38" x 56" (size) but due to construction of RCC duct near Village Burail, the size has reduced to 32" which is hampering the capacity of the line. The frequent blocking of this line resulted into multiple collapses of this egg shaped sewer around the year resulting in financial losses to MC Chandigarh. The MCC plans to lay a parallel alternate sewer line using an 800mm (32") i/d RCC pipe NP-3 with HDPE lining. This new line will have an approximate length of 660 meters and will include the construction of machine hole chambers. It will also connect with the existing (24" x 36") line to alleviate the excessive sewer load on the main trunk (34" x 51") at the roundabout of sector 33/44. This project aims to improve the sewerage system and prevent further financial losses for MC Chandigarh.

column7: STRENGTHENING, PROVIDING AND LAYING OF 250MM (10”) i/d SW PIPE SEWER LINE AT COLONIES IN SECTOR 25, CHANDIGARH
column10: MCC will spend around approx. Rs. 4.61 Crore for this work. The population density in colonies (i.e. Janta Colony, Bhaskar Colony & Kumhar Colony) of Sector 25 had increased rapidly by 1.3 times within decade and is expected to reach from 27,000 to 36,664 by the year 2053. The existing sewerage system, consisting of 150 mm diameter sewer lines, has become incapable of handling the excess load of sewage generated by the native households. As a result, the sewerage is overflowing resulting into water borne diseases. This is also causing contamination in the drinking water. Moreover, in addition to increased population, the per capita consumption/supply of water (i.e. 245 LPCD, which is approx. 1.8 times more than Standard Norms set by the Govt, of India) also contributed towards excess generation of sewage/waste water as well. The Municipal Corporation Chandigarh on day to day basis is also facing difficulties during maintenance, addressing the complaints regarding blockages, overflowing, etc. This project aims to improve the sewerage system and to avoid inconveniences by replacing the rising 150 mm (6") to 200mm (8") dia lines with 200mm (8”) i/d and 250mm (10”) i/d dia sewer lines to take the increased flow which improves the overall sewerage network.

column7: Rejuvenation and Beautification of Ratan Talav
column10:
AMRUT 2.0: Ratan Talav is located in ward 7 of Baruch Municipality. Ratan Talav is an estimated 400-year-old Pond. The main purpose behind building this Pond was to provide drinking water at that time. There are twelve abyssal wells in Ratan Talav. About 200 turtles and other aquatic animals live here. Currently, the water is polluted due to stagnant water as well as the insertion of drain water. Due to stagnant water blue-green algae has also accumulated in the water. There is an urgent need to beautify and renovate/rejuvenate this lake. So the project of beautification, as well as renovation of Ratan Talav, is proposed.
Existing Scenario: 
• Existing situation of the Lake water mixed with drainage & sewage waste. 
• Polluted Water, improper boundary. 
• No proper Tortoise conservation area. 
• Unsafe conservation area provided for Tortoise. 
• No space provided for visitors to the tortoise conservation area. 
Proposed: 
• Stop drainage & sewage water into lake and to provide soak pit well for encroachment area. 
• Sludge disposed from by drain pump. 
• Purification of water as much as possible. 
• Providing R.C.C. retaining wall with stone pitching. 
• Provision of Tortoise conservation pond. 
• Provision of moveable water. 
• Also provision of visitor viewing point. 
• Dewatering and filling fresh water

 Average project site elevations are 1440 meter from MSL.

Nirmand town is the Sub Divisional Head quarter and also the center of the Nirmand Block.

 It is 177 Km from District Head quarter Kullu, and 157 Km from Bhunter Air Port and 145 KM away from State Capital Shimla.
The climate in Nirmand is predominantly cold during winter and moderately cool during summer. 

The average temperature during summer is between 14 °C and 30 °C and between 4 °C and 18 °C in the winter.
On average, some 25 mm of precipitation is received during winter and spring months, increasing to some 100 mm in summer as the monsoon approaches.
 
Nirmand Town rarely  experiences snowfall. The month of December and January are usually the coldest.

About the Project :-Water supply scheme to Town Nirmand is proposed in the lift water supply scheme by tapping the  perennial source of water "Kurpan Khadd" near Pokhni. The water supply scheme also include the various offices i.e Police Station ,Tehsil office ,BDO office , Horticulture office , Agriculture office and Treasury office and other institution of town. 

Sewerage Scheme: -   This project mainly intends to address health and environmental concerns caused by the flow of untreated sewage in the environment 
The Newly created Nagar Panchayat Nirmand & adjoining area are ecologically sensitive and are the most frequently visited destinations.

There is no sewerage system in Nirmand Town and its adjoining areas..

Approximately  0.42 MLD water is being supplied to the Nirmand Town & the same is being enhanced to about 0.84 MLD.(Current (2021)population of Nirmand Town is approximately 4442 and other population is 1022 persons) with a floating population of about 3500 persons per day.
Presently there is no proper existing sewerage network and treatment facility in the Nirmand Town.

 Presently sewage in adjoining area is being managed with Septic Tanks and  soak pits which causes over flow in drains.

The increase in untreated wastewater quantities generated by rapid growth of hotel industries, tourism business are major concern.

 The large volume of untreated sewage discharged daily in the valley, continues to be a real problem of pollution throughout the region.

With large-scale deforestation in the catchment area, the quantity of water has decreased considerably and compelled to abandon the treatment plants.

column7: Providing and laying of raw pipelines from Thoubal Multipurpose project to Andro Town
column10:
The proposed project is bringing  raw water from Thoubal Multi purpose project to Treatment  units at Andro Santhei park which is 28 Km by 200 mm dia. 

Andro Town is in Keirao block in Imphal East District lies on the northern side of Imphal-Yairipok road  at a geographical location of  24º45'14.17" N latitude and 94º02'08.45" E longitude.  It is 22 km away from the capital Imphal . Andro Town  have 12 (twelve) wards and resided by a Scheduled Caste community . The total population of Andro Town  is 8744 Heads (2011 - census). There are educational institutions, police stations, electricity Offices, PH Centres and etc. besides small business & marketing centre etc. However, there is no source of water for living rather than depending on this Thoubal Multipurpose project. Small ponds, tube wells are there but it is not perennial and dried up in the winter season. Hence, it is highly required to provide pipelines from Thoubal project to Andro Town.

column7: Laying 2400mm dia Raw Water Main from DSB near Haiderpur WTP to Wazirabad
column10:
It is a water quality improvement project and will not enhance any additional house hold connections. 

2400mm dia Water Main is proposed to be laid from Delhi Sub Branch (DSB) near Haiderpur WTP to Wazirabad intake works in a length of 11 KM to transfer raw water from DSB to Wazirabad. Against the requirement of 490 cusec raw water at Wazirabad for WTPs at Wazirabad, Chandrawal and Okhla, existing 2400 mm.dia Twin raw water mains can carry upto  370 cusec of water from CLC near Haiderpur to Wazirabad & balance 120 cusec has to be  lifted through river course. But, as  raw water through river course gets contaminated frequently due to release of waste water/industrial waste probably from drain No.2 or 6 in the territory of Haryana in the river course the  proposal for laying 3rd raw water main from CLC chamber near Haiderpur upto outfall at Wazirabad has been  sanctioned by Board to lay 3rd  2400 mm dia raw water main to carry 120 cusec shortfall & additional water in case of saving in seepage losses due to lining of DSB in future and also to act as standby in case of any shut down of one main. This main will carry raw water from Haiderpur WTP to Wazirabad intake as gravity main. Further arrangements will be made to pump raw water and from Wazirabad intake to Haider Pur WTP in case of shortage of raw water at Haiderpur and availability of water in Yamuna river.

column10:
प्रस्तुत योजना जनपद देहरादून के विकासखण्ड रायपुर के अन्तर्गत सेरकी क्षेत्र में बांदल नदी में बादल नहर के शीर्ष पर जल सरक्षण एव्ं संवर्द्वन हेतु गठित की गयी है। बांदल नहर का शीर्ष मालदेवता सरखेत मोटर मार्ग पर पर देहरादून से लगभग 13 कि0मी0 दूरी पर सेरकी ग्राम में लाल पुल के समीप स्थित है। बांदल नहर द्वारा सेरकी ग्राम की 10 हैक्टेयर कृषि भूमि हेतु सिंचन जल उपलब्ध कराया जाता है  नदी का जलस्तर न्यून हो जाने के कारण कृषकों केा सिंचाई हेतु पर्याप्त जल उपलब्ध नही हो पा रहा हैं। जिस कारण कृषकों के फसल उत्पादन एवं गुणवत्ता पर विपरीत प्रभाव पड रहा है। इसके अतिरिक्त पेयजल हेतु जल संस्थान द्वारा 11 क्यूसेक की अतिरिक्त मांग की जा रही है।
अतः नहर के शीर्ष पर वियर निर्माण कर जल संरक्षण किया जाना हैं। जिससे वियर में एकत्रित जल को कृषकों की आवश्यकतानुसार उपलब्ध कराया जा सकेगा एवं फसल उत्पादन एवं गुणवत्ता में सुधार हो सकेगा। साथ ही पेयजल की मांग के अनुसार अतिरिक्त पानी की आपूर्ति भी की जानी सम्भव हो सकेगी।
योजना में बादल नदी पर 30 मी0 लम्बाई व 1.30 मी0 ऊँचाई में प्रबलित सीमेंट कंक्रीट का वियर निर्माण किया जाना प्रस्तावित हैं।
